fields.key_provisions: Published chapter/code site-assessment framework requires an applicant's sound assessment before specified local approvals for a new facility reasonably anticipated to require at least 100 MW of retail utility power. Sound impacts concern homes and schools within 500 feet of the facility property boundary; other resource assessments are optional, and utility substation/voltage information is also required subject to stated qualifications. The framework preserves the existing-approval/expansion exception; its phrase “does not exceed an additional 100 megawatts or more” is not converted into a definitive boundary here. The chapter labels the provision 15.2-2209.4; the observed code publishes it as 15.2-2209.5. Later force is not independently confirmed.

fields.key_provisions: Published water-reporting act requires covered registered offsite suppliers to report potable and reclaimed water separately for qualifying air-permitted data centers. Other use categories are required to the extent available without utility billing-system modifications; quarterly volumes may substitute where monthly data are unavailable. The act expressly becomes effective 2027-01-01; enactment does not establish that it was already operative at the observation date.

fields.key_provisions: Would prevent utility costs substantially related to serving data center customers of 100 MW or more from being recovered from non-data-center customers unless rates substantially recover those costs from data centers. The introduced cost condition also requires that the relevant costs would not have been incurred but for that data-center demand.
